decision: Which scan picture (S-A, S-B, S-C) and which dashboard staging (D-A, D-B), for Savar and his team?
primary_axis: scan: realism versus legibility of the app screen; dashboard: web first versus phone first
invariants: Everything else as r161: layout B, open workbook on a paper band, Maya video, 'built from' next workbook, closing cards
The scan picture shows the open workbook (Day 1, pages 1 and 2) with Leah's answers, and our app
The dashboard chips move the web and the phone together

options.bet: Overhead photo: the open workbook on a kitchen table, a hand holds the phone over page 1; our pages and app put on an AI base photo
options.benefit: Looks like a real photo of our product in use
options.cost: The phone is small in a full-width picture, so the app screen is hard to read
options.risk: The base photo is AI generated; a parent or the team may prefer our own photo

options.bet: Built flat lay, no photo: the open workbook on a table colour, our phone floating over page 1
options.benefit: No AI image; crisp; the app screen is large
options.cost: Reads as a render, not a photo
options.risk: Can look like a stock mockup

options.bet: The S-A photo cropped close on the phone, beside the text
options.benefit: Real and readable: the marked result is easy to read
options.cost: Shows only part of the open workbook
options.risk: The spread is less clear than in S-A

options.bet: Web first: the clickable web dashboard, with the phone app beside it; chips move both
options.benefit: Shows the full detail, and that the app has the same account
options.cost: The phone covers the right edge of the web view
options.risk: Parents may think they need a computer

options.bet: Phone first: a large phone app screen in front, the web dashboard behind it
options.benefit: Matches how most parents will check in: on the phone
options.cost: The web menu is behind the phone; only the chips move it
options.risk: The web detail is hard to see

picked: S-A (overhead photo) and D-A (web first, phone beside)
outcome: Savar, 2026-10-29: likes r162. Scan: S-A. Dashboard: D-A. Build the page in the worktree and open a PR to refine from.
